newsitem.title: CHINA: China arrests woman, 58, for $24 million swindle.
newsitem.headline: China arrests woman, 58, for $24 million swindle.

text.p: Police in eastern China have arrested a 58-year-old woman for swindling businesses out of more than 200 million yuan ($24 million) since 1994, the China Women's Daily said on Monday.

Police in Linyi city in Shandong province said Wang Baoqin, a retired factory worker, set up a steel trading company and used it to swindle huge sums of money out of more than 20 local enterprises, the newspaper said.
Wang, who had previously served three years in jail for fraud, had spent about 10 million yuan on jewelry and high living, it said.
Police were still investigating the case, it said but gave no further details. ($1=8.3 yuan)
